tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List every project inside a Mod Constructor bundle. A bundle usually holds one project; returns an array either way.

bundle.description: Serialized .mcbundle.json content. Omit for an empty workspace.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Get full metadata (name, author, version, status, changelog, item counts) for the project in a bundle.

tools.name: list_careers
tools.title: List careers
tools.description: List every career in the bundle with a compact summary (name, type, branch count, level count).

tools.name: list_traits
tools.title: List traits
tools.description: List every trait in the bundle with category, age gates, and buff count.

tools.name: list_aspirations
tools.title: List aspirations
tools.description: List every aspiration in the bundle with milestone count and reward-trait reference.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.description: List every notification template in the bundle with visual style and title.

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: Create a fresh Mod Constructor project bundle. Returns an empty bundle ready for authoring tools.

name.description: Project name shown to the mod's audience.

tools.name: add_career
tools.title: Add career
tools.description: Add a Sims 4 career (with branches, levels, salary, schedule) to a bundle. Returns the updated bundle.

internalId.description: Snake-case identifier used in tuning (e.g. career_astronaut).

tools.name: add_trait
tools.title: Add trait
tools.description: Add a Sims 4 trait (with buffs, age gates, and category) to a bundle. Returns the updated bundle.

tools.name: add_aspiration
tools.title: Add aspiration
tools.description: Add a Sims 4 aspiration (with ordered milestones and optional reward trait) to a bundle.

tools.name: add_notification
tools.title: Add notification template
tools.description: Add an in-game notification template (toast, modal, banner, milestone, or phone) to a bundle.

tools.name: set_project_status
tools.title: Set project status
tools.description: Set the project's lifecycle status. Moving to complete/tested/released auto-appends a changelog entry.

notes.description: Changelog note appended when marking complete/tested/released.

tools.name: bump_version
tools.title: Bump version
tools.description: Set a new semantic version on the project and reset status to in-progress, enforcing the release lifecycle.

tools.name: export_bundle
tools.title: Export .mcbundle.json
tools.description: Return the bundle as a downloadable .mcbundle.json string plus a suggested filename. The user re-imports it into Mod Constructor V6 via File → Import.

tools.name: import_bundle
tools.title: Import .mcbundle.json
tools.description: Parse and validate a .mcbundle.json string. Returns the normalized bundle if valid.

contents.description: Raw JSON text of a .mcbundle.json file.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: List built-in templates
tools.description: List Mod Constructor V6's built-in starter templates (careers, traits, aspirations, notifications) with metadata.

tools.name: use_template
tools.title: Scaffold from template
tools.description: Scaffold a built-in template's records into a bundle. Use list_templates first to get valid IDs.

tools.name: list_snippets
tools.title: List snippets
tools.description: List Mod Constructor V6's built-in XML/tuning snippets (buffs, loots, tests, interactions).
